title: ～かどうか (〜ka dou ka)
shortExplanation: Used to express 'whether' or 'if' in indirect questions or statements.
longExplanation: The ～かどうか grammar point is used to express 'whether' or 'if' in indirect questions or statements. It is often used to express uncertainty or to inquire about information in a more polite form. ～かどうか can be used with verbs, い-adjectives, な-adjectives, and nouns.
formation: Verb-casual + かどうか, い-Adjective + かどうか, な-Adjective + (だ)かどうか, Noun + (だ)かどうか

examples.jp: 彼が来るかどうか知りません。
examples.romaji: Kare ga kuru ka dou ka shirimasen.
examples.en: I don't know if he will come or not.

examples.jp: この本が面白いかどうか教えてください。
examples.romaji: Kono hon ga omoshiroi ka dou ka oshiete kudasai.
examples.en: Please tell me if this book is interesting or not.

examples.jp: 彼女が綺麗だかどうかは分かりません。
examples.romaji: Kanojo ga kirei da ka dou ka wa wakarimasen.
examples.en: I don't know whether she is beautiful or not.

examples.jp: 彼が先生だかどうか覚えていません。
examples.romaji: Kare ga sensei da ka dou ka oboete imasen.
examples.en: I don't remember if he is a teacher or not.
